text:
Alex: Morning — planning a gradual canary for prompt-batcher today. Target: 10% -> 50% over 30m starting 12:00 UTC. Who can own smoke and rollback?
Maria: I can own smoke checks. will post quick checklist in a sec.
Jon: Quick Q — which cohorts are we using? same geo bucketing as last time?
Alex: yes — cohorts: 10% US-west heavy, next step 25% add EU, final 50% includes APAC small slice. rollout policy: 5m waits between increments, 2m smoke window.
Sam: FYI the feature flag is gated under ff/prompt-batcher-v2. have the toggle ready.
Maria: Smoke checklist (short):
- external latency gauge (p99) < 400ms
- 95th token cost within expected band
- no increase in 5xx across router backends
- spot-run evaluation against baseline prompts
Commands:
```
# smoke request
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rbw-prompt-batcher","input":"smoke test short prompt"}'

# tail logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=rbw-batcher --tail=200
```
Maria: I'll run those at +2m after each step and report.
Alex: Who's on rollback? Sam? Sue?
Sam: I can do rollback if needed. rollback plan: flip ff/prompt-batcher-v2 -> off, and scale old variant up via k8s rollout restart on svc=rbw-batcher-stable for fast warmup. I have creds.
Sue: I reviewed the PR this morning — no outstanding comments. :thumbsup:
Jon: Any perf regressions from the perf tests in staging? last run looked OK but flagged a slight mem bump.
Maria: saw ~8% mem bump on staging under load test; not visible in canary baseline, but will watch. If mem >20% increase we abort.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary 1767777000 -> increments: 10% @12:00 UTC, 25% @12:10 UTC, 50% @12:25 UTC. Notifying on-call.
deploy-bot: on-call: Sam (pager), secondary: Alex
Alex: OK plan: Maria runs smoke, Sam ready for rollback, Jon monitoring metrics dashboards, Sue LGTM for code. If all green we'll proceed. Ping here with each step result.
Maria: starting first smoke now.
Maria: smoke step 10% — external latency p50 110ms, p95 360ms, p99 390ms, no 5xx seen. samples look good. :white_check_mark:
Jon: dash looks stable, traces clean.
Sam: ready to standby for rollback. I've sanity-tested the flip command.
Alex: moving to 25% in 5m. See you in thread for updates.
Maria: smoke at 25% — p95 380ms, one transient 502 on a single router (retry handled). investigating but not blocking. marking as proceed.
deploy-bot: canary progressed to 25% (1767777180)
Alex: good. next hold, monitoring for 15m before 50% bump.
Maria: holding. will run sample evals and post a small diff summary.
Maria: eval sample diffs: 2/200 minor formatting differences, no hallucination increase. proceeding.
Sam: all rollback hooks ready. I have the ff toggle command prepped:
```
# rollback toggle
curl -X POST https://featureflag.internal/v1/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"ff/prompt-batcher-v2","state":"off"}'
```
Sue: tagging infra in case we need fast scale: @infra-ops
Alex: thanks team. we'll hold here. if anyone sees spike >threshold call it.
Maria: no spikes so far. :thumbsup:
Alex: final bump to 50% at ~12:25 if still green. will post final confirmation then.
Maria: 50% smoke done — p95 410ms (slightly above target), but token cost stable and errors flat. recommend continue but flag for follow-up perf tuning.
Jon: noted — created perf ticket and assigned to eng-runtime.
Alex: continuing rollout to 50% now. thanks everyone. :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary completed to 50% (1767777399)
